meta.phase-name: Payload CRUD, Revisions, And Publish Receipts

phase-plan.purpose: Build the next authoring layer on top of the working Payload import/export/publish backbone: add browser-based pack JSON editing, project custom schema and platform extension creation, draft revision history, publish-job receipts, and the migration/typegen changes needed to persist those records in the DB.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: new revision/publish-job collections and migration, authoring service revision and publish receipt recording, content-app pack editor UI, create flows for custom schemas and docs-site/Payload platform data, route/registry fixes so the authoring flow reads engine source contracts directly, and architecture/planning updates. Out of scope: rich validation reports, diff visualizers, revision restore actions, and full schema-driven form generation.

file.description: Payload collection for durable draft revision records across pack docs, custom schemas, and platform extensions.
Payload collection for publish pipeline receipts, command history, export file lists, and engine write results.
Records revisions and publish jobs, exposes them in project detail, and consumes the canonical engine source contracts directly for the authoring flow.
Browser workspace for editing pack JSON, creating custom schemas/platform data, and viewing revision and publish history.
Serves the canonical content pack registry from engine source contracts instead of relying on packaged engine dist resolution.
Added a safe generated-codec fallback so authoring/import flows can keep consuming canonical source JSON when the generated decoder is stricter than the live schema.
Migration for draft revisions and publish jobs.
Architecture doc updates for the new authoring history/receipt layer and source-contract registry resolution.

task.description: Add durable revision and publish-job collections plus service-layer recording hooks.
Build the browser workspace for pack JSON editing and create flows for custom schemas and docs-site/Payload platform data.
Fix the authoring registry/bootstrap path so it consumes canonical engine source contracts directly and survives current generated decoder drift.

decision.summary: Content-editor registry and authoring import paths now consume the engine source contract module directly instead of the packaged engine dist.
decision.impact: Keeps authoring/import/export working even when the published engine package is temporarily behind or stricter than the canonical source schema.

decision.summary: Revision and publish-job persistence landed before richer validation UI.
decision.impact: Gives the editor durable operational history now, while leaving validation reports as the next slice rather than blocking the CRUD loop.
